name: lmstudio-agent
description: Connect Claude Desktop to LM Studio as an external AI agent
long_description: Use local LM Studio models as external agents to delegate tasks, get second opinions, or leverage specialized models for specific tasks. Uses OpenAI-compatible API. Built from the canonical mcp-local-llm TypeScript implementation, not a separately maintained copy.

allow_remote_llm.title: Allow Remote/LAN LLM (advanced)
allow_remote_llm.description: Set to 1 to allow a non-loopback LM Studio server URL (LAN/remote). Denied by default -- also requires Allowed LLM Hosts below.

allowed_llm_hosts.title: Allowed LLM Hosts (advanced)
allowed_llm_hosts.description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs permitted when Allow Remote/LAN LLM is enabled.

allow_destructive_tools.title: Allow Destructive Tools (advanced)
allow_destructive_tools.description: Disabled by default. LM Studio manages models via its own UI; no destructive tools currently apply to this provider.
